name: Icey – Extension archiver
author: Icedor Johansson

sections.description:
WordPress warns about inactive plugins because they can pose security risks if left outdated. Icey – WP Plugin Archive Manager helps you mitigate this by moving inactive plugins to a secure archive folder, keeping them isolated from WordPress while still available for later use.

With a dedicated admin tab, you can easily restore archived plugins whenever needed—without cluttering your active plugin list or compromising security.

Localization

  • English (default)
  • Swedish (sv_SE)
sections.installation:
1. Find the plugin in the WordPress repository or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Go to the Plugins page in your WordPress admin and activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I uninstall the plugin?

Simply deactivate and delete it from the Plugins page.
